answer.answerText: No. ADR-043 did not cause the specific ExecutionConfiguration refactor; the refactor injected TradingCalculatorService into PaperSettlementService to support Story 0042's realized-PnL settlement.

claims.text: ADR-043 explicitly excludes PAPER EXIT implementation and PAPER realized-PnL settlement from its scope.
Story 0042 required local exit settlement and realized PnL using the existing calculator.
The Story 0042 commit changed ExecutionConfiguration only by adding TradingCalculatorService to the PaperSettlementService bean wiring.
The specific refactor is attributable to Story 0042's settlement implementation, while ADR-043 was contextual architecture rather than the direct cause.

evidence.excerpt: This ADR does not decide or implement: PAPER position-query implementation; PAPER EXIT implementation; PAPER realized-PnL settlement.
Added local exit settlement and realized PnL using the existing calculator.
PaperSettlementService bean wiring adds a TradingCalculatorService parameter and passes it to the constructor.
